infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FlareLens uses the camera to photograph foods and beverages so Gemini can identify ingredients linked to eczema flare-ups.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FlareLens accesses your photo library so you can select meal photos for ingredient analysis.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FlareLens uses your location to automatically log local weather, humidity, season, and pollen/allergen levels.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: FlareLens reads step and motion activity to automatically estimate daily exercise quantities.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: FlareLens optionally reads sleep, workout, and HRV metrics from Apple Health to correlate them with eczema severity.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow FlareLens to automatically collect weather, humidity, and local allergen levels.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow FlareLens to select food photos for Gemini ingredient analysis.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow FlareLens to capture food photos for Gemini ingredient analysis.
